text: The difference-in-differences treatment effect is unstable over time: it loses significance in June and July 2012, then becomes significant again in August and September 2012 with negative coefficients and in October 2012 with a positive coefficient.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Barbara Luppi, Sandra Paterlini, Did the Dodd-Frank Act Impact Hedge Fund Performance (2014). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2389416
